# Plan Result

## Epic

- Path: `epics/epic-01-actor-check/`
- Goal: one place owns the actor check (look the user up, refuse an unknown one, refuse one with no role), so the two new call sites reuse it.
- Scope: a shared helper in `src/users.js` and every existing copy in `src/` replaced by it. Messages and refusals stay the same. The two new call sites and any change to authorization rules are out of scope.

## Stories

- `story-01-01-extract-actor-check` (FAST, one `story.md`). It is the only story, so it also serves as the walking skeleton.

## First Story To Run

`story-01-01-extract-actor-check`

## Generated Files

- `epics/epic-01-actor-check/index.md`
- `epics/epic-01-actor-check/story-01-01-extract-actor-check/story.md`

I checked that both files exist and that `doctor` runs. It reported no story-numbering or epic-size problems. Its two warnings were about the install: the project docs are still templates, and the guard hook needs `ai-flow upgrade`. I made no code changes.

## Assumptions

- Messages and order of checks are the contract: `unknown actor: <id>` and `actor has no role: <id>`. In `createExpense` the actor check runs before field validation.
- The `POST /expenses` route copy can be deleted without any visible change. `createExpense` runs the same checks right after it, in the same order, with the same messages.

## Risks

- **The copies are not identical.** `rejectExpense` (`src/approvals.js:29`) only refuses unknown actors, so an actor with no role can reject today.
  - The plan keeps that behaviour with two helpers, `requireActor` and `requireActorWithRole`. `rejectExpense` uses the first one.
  - Whether a role-less actor should be able to reject is an authorization question I did not decide. If it's a bug, it needs its own story.
- **No test covers role-less actors today.** All four users in `USERS` have a role. The story adds characterization tests first, which pass on the current code, then refactors with those tests unchanged. The `test` script in `package.json` lists spec files by hand, so new spec files must be added there.

## Clarification Readiness

ready. No open question would change the implementation.

## Recommended Next Command

Use `/flow-run` on `epics/epic-01-actor-check/story-01-01-extract-actor-check`.
